name: state-transition-mapping
description: Map UI state machines for a component, screen, or flow. Enumerates states (idle / loading / success / error / empty / partial), transitions with triggers and guards, terminal vs transient states, and invalid-state detection. Produces visual state chart + acceptance criteria per state. Distinct from user-flow-diagramming (task-level) and micro-interaction-design (interaction-level). Mermaid diagrams with optional PNG export.
